opening.argument: The presentation urges viewers to join Forsage through network marketing while promising thousands of dollars in BUSD daily and a rapid path to $69,300. It directs them to install Trust Wallet and deposit $85 in BUSD, then claims that three partners activating slots will return that investment instantly. The structure depends on repeated purchases through X3 and X4, with later slots costing and generating twice as much and partners continuing through the matrix to slot 12. Although it says income is not guaranteed and requires effort, that qualification does not remove the central recruitment-based earnings pitch or the claimed automatic return of the initial deposit.
